extras: Requires APL385 font for optimal visual appearance.
intentEvidence: this plugin render the tick notation like this [code example] into this [code example] using the RIDE convention.
problem: Standard Markdown rendering does not correctly display APL tick notation or specialized APL Unicode characters within code blocks.
summary: A code block renderer that converts APL tick notation into APL Unicode using the RIDE convention when the language is set to `apl`.
